args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args) == 2L)
input <- args[[1]]
output <- args[[2]]

library(splines)

d <- read.csv(input, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area") %in% names(d)))

parse_p <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, ":", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) != 2L) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
  if (anyNA(vals) || any(vals < 0) || sum(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  vals[[1]] / sum(vals)
}

make_scope <- function(dat, lo, hi) {
  fit_models <- list(
    quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  rows <- list()
  for (model_name in names(fit_models)) {
    m <- fit_models[[model_name]]
    n <- length(residuals(m))
    k <- length(coef(m))
    rss <- sum(residuals(m)^2)
    sigma <- summary(m)$sigma
    aic <- AIC(m)
    bic <- BIC(m)
    adjr2 <- summary(m)$adj.r.squared
    grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=20001L)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata=data.frame(p=grid))
    idx <- which.max(pred)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      model = model_name,
      n = n,
      k = k,
      rss = rss,
      sigma = sigma,
      AIC = aic,
      BIC = bic,
      adjR2 = adjr2,
      opt_p = grid[[idx]],
      opt_pred = pred[[idx]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$scope <- attr(dat, "scope")
  out
}

# Mixture-only scope
d_mix <- d[d$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop=FALSE]
d_mix$p <- vapply(d_mix$Ratio, parse_p, numeric(1))
d_mix <- d_mix[!is.na(d_mix$p) & is.finite(d_mix$Area), , drop=FALSE]
attr(d_mix, "scope") <- "mix_only"
stopifnot(nrow(d_mix) > 3L)

# Boundary scope: pure 287 (p=1), pure 98 (p=0), and 287_98 mixtures.
pure <- d[d$StrainNumber %in% c("287", "98"), , drop=FALSE]
pure$p <- ifelse(pure$StrainNumber == "287", 1, 0)
bound <- data.frame(
  p = c(pure$p, d_mix$p),
  Area = c(pure$Area, d_mix$Area),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
bound <- bound[!is.na(bound$p) & is.finite(bound$Area), , drop=FALSE]
attr(bound, "scope") <- "boundary"
stopifnot(nrow(bound) > 3L)

mix_res <- make_scope(d_mix, min(d_mix$p), max(d_mix$p))
bound_res <- make_scope(bound, 0, 1)

all_res <- rbind(mix_res, bound_res)
all_res <- all_res[, c("scope", "model", "n", "k", "rss", "sigma", "AIC", "BIC", "adjR2", "opt_p", "opt_pred")]
write.table(all_res, file=output, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)

RSCRIPT
